# Map of the Markets. Interactive S&P 500 Heatmap on a World Map. ## Explore the S&P 500 heatmap and global stock market map on an interactive world map that shows company, sector, and index performance in real time. Instead of viewing markets in abstract grids, Troutwood Maps lets you explore the stock market map on an interactive world map. Track trends across the S&P 500, NASDAQ, and global indices. See market performance on a geographic world map — not a grid. Whether you want a high-level view of the global economy or a deep dive into specific companies, Troutwood helps you understand what’s driving the markets. Select the S&P 500 heatmap, choose another index, or explore publicly traded companies around the world using advanced filters. Unlike traditional heatmaps, Troutwood visualizes market data on an actual world map, giving you a geographic perspective on stock performance that’s intuitive, engaging, and easy to understand.
